# legacy/grid — READ-ONLY reference

Snapshot of the old GRID codebase (Tmall MD-RQ-VAE + MFD work) plus the
`rec-tmall/` analysis scripts that produced the measured properties.

* Do not edit. Do not import from `macrec/` or anything else in this repo.
* Use it only as the citation target for `docs/` (file:line).
* All W&B keys have been replaced by `REDACTED_ROTATE_ME`; these scripts will
  not run as-is (paths point to /scratch/yw8866/... artifacts and the Tmall data).
* License: see `LICENSE` (Snap Inc., non-commercial research only).
* Provenance: see `/PROVENANCE.md`.
